stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import json
h,w=17,18
g=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
# Preserve edge sequence seeds
g[0][:4]=[9,5,3,4]
g[16][:4]=[2,1,3,8]
g[16][14:18]=[4,5,6,7]
# Expand each isolated seed using its corresponding cyclic sequence, aligned at seed color
placements=[(1,11,[2,1,3,8]),(3,3,[9,5,3,4]),(5,13,[4,5,6,7]),(9,7,[2,1,3,8]),(11,13,[2,1,3,8]),(13,4,[4,5,6,7])]
for r,c,seq in placements:
    v=g[r][c]
    # test markers entered below; infer matching index from color
    idx=seq.index(v)
    start=c-idx
    for k,x in enumerate(seq):
        cc=start+k
        if 0<=cc<w:g[r][cc]=x
# marker singles that were not prefilled (all marker colors)
for r,c,v in [(1,11,8),(3,3,9),(5,13,6),(9,7,1),(11,13,2),(13,4,7)]:
    # placement routine selected correct sequence, but original markers need be seeded
    pass
# Above rows started blank, so restore/add markers and proper patterns explicitly
for r,c,v,seq in [(1,11,8,[2,1,3,8]),(3,3,9,[9,5,3,4]),(5,13,6,[4,5,6,7]),(9,7,1,[2,1,3,8]),(11,13,2,[2,1,3,8]),(13,4,7,[4,5,6,7])]:
    idx=seq.index(v); start=c-idx
    for k,x in enumerate(seq):
        cc=start+k
        if 0<=cc<w:g[r][cc]=x
assert len(g)==17 and all(len(row)==18 for row in g)
print(json.dumps(g,separators=(',',':')))
